item.name: Feedback Diode
item.description: First hostile shot touching you during an equipped dash deals fixed 24 secondary damage to its living shooter. Once per dash; no extra immunity.
item.trigger: Actual hostile-shot contact during a dash that began while equipped
item.cost: 1 module slot; no contact/blast counter; weapon bonuses do not scale feedback
item.stack_rule: Unique: maximum 1; buying or syncing never arms an ongoing dash

pair.name: CROSSCURRENT
pair.description: Dash pushes nearby enemies and can counter one hostile shot to its living shooter. Complementary effects; no extra multiplier.
